question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The patient's family had to go through a lot of trouble to_________ her into a hospital.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e., 'admit'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• **join - **link; connect. (में शामिल होने के)
 
• **admit - **receive (a patient) into a hospital for treatment. (दाखिल करना)
 
• **access - **the means or opportunity to approach or enter a place. (पहुंच)
 
• **permit - **officially allow (someone) to do something. (अनुज्ञा-पत्र) 
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would imply the patient's admission into the hospital. 
 
• Thus, **option 2 **or **admit ** is the best fit word for the given blank.
